safetyBehavior: A helper READY profile identity is derived from the selected Electron userData path and overwrites any inherited CLIPNEST_STABLE_PROFILE_ID.

At most one supervisor restart is attempted; a replacement waits for confirmed old-helper exit. An unconfirmed clipboard side effect fences every Electron clipboard write until that process exit is confirmed.
The selected item version is rechecked after prepare and immediately before clipboard commit; stale content is cancelled before writing.
Confirmed clipboard write followed by paste failure returns copied_only; a lost commit or input acknowledgement is unknown and is never resent.
Renderer maps copy outcomes to distinct notices, drops old-generation results, and forwards Enter; the user explicitly accepted the T03 scope and directed continuation.

The main process sends both the remaining selection budget and a shared monotonic tick deadline. Helper waits and commit/input boundaries enforce the earlier local or shared deadline; legacy budget-only click semantics remain compatible.
The helper rechecks local and shared deadlines after the clipboard lock and after INPUT construction immediately before sequence validation and SendInput.

Before clipboard commit, a still-current explicit selection may fall back to Electron clipboard-only. T04 now supplies bounded PNG/JPEG decoding in a production utility process; complete image auto-paste acceptance remains open.
